config system interface
    edit "port1"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 172.16.0.2 255.255.255.252
        set status up
    next
    edit "port2"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 10.2.0.1 255.255.255.0
        set status up
    next
end
config router static
    edit 1
        set dst 198.51.100.42 255.255.255.255
        set gateway 172.16.0.1
        set device "port1"
    next
end
config firewall address
    edit "REMOTE_HOST"
        set subnet 198.51.100.42 255.255.255.255
    next
end
config firewall service custom
    edit "HTTPS"
        set protocol TCP/UDP/SCTP
        set tcp-portrange 443
    next
end
config firewall vip
    edit "WEB"
        set extintf "port1"
        set extip 203.0.113.15
        set mappedip "10.2.0.15"
    next
end
config firewall policy
    edit 10
        set name "web-in"
        set srcintf "port1"
        set dstintf "port2"
        set srcaddr "REMOTE_HOST"
        set dstaddr "WEB"
        set service "HTTPS"
        set schedule "always"
        set action accept
        set status enable
    next
    edit 20
        set name "return-deny"
        set srcintf "port2"
        set dstintf "port1"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set service "ALL"
        set schedule "always"
        set action deny
        set status enable
    next
end
